title: When a tool is returned needing repair, take it out of lending
statement: Whenever a tool is returned with the condition `needs_repair`, report damage on it, with the return note as the damage note (or "Returned needing repair." when there is none). When the tool already needs repair, its first damage report stands (TL-LEND-INV02) and nothing changes. A return recorded as `good` invokes nothing, so it never clears damage. The reaction follows the return's commit, in its own transaction, and is never lost: Tool returned is delivered by outbox, so if the reaction fails, the return still stands and the reaction is tried again.

title: When a loan is opened, remind its member the day before it is due
statement: Every loan opened is reminded on the day before its due date, in the library's time zone: the library's clock looks once a day for the active loans due the next day whose member has not been reminded, and reminds each member of each such loan, saying the tool and the due date, and that the loan can be renewed once while it has not been. A loan due that day is reminded too, so a day the clock missed is made up. A returned loan is not reminded, and a loan's member is reminded at most once (TL-LEND-INV08): a renewal does not bring a second reminder, and a reminder that could not be sent is not tried again.
